rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an unsafe condition (icy walkway), which is the classic definition of premises liability.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter fell on policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm and sustained a broken wrist. Medical bills are expected. This is a premises liability claim with pediatric injury requiring prompt investigation and claim management.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
